name: finviz/screener
description: Screen US stocks on Finviz with filter codes for valuation, performance, technicals and fundamentals, returning matching tickers with price, change, market cap and key ratios.

filters.description: Comma-separated Finviz filter codes (e.g. 'fa_peg_u1' for PEG under 1, 'ta_sma200_pc5' for price within 5% of SMA200). Codes follow the Finviz URL parameter format visible in screener URLs.

# Finviz Stock Screener

Screen US stocks on Finviz with filter codes for valuation, performance, technicals and fundamentals, returning matching tickers with price, change, market cap and key ratios.
